formula.summary: Score out of 100 for a small South African business. CVSS contributes up to 40, CISA KEV contributes 25 or 0, FIRST EPSS contributes up to 20, and a match against the configurable small-business software list contributes 15 or 0. Each part is rounded to one decimal, then added, and the total is capped at 100. Missing data scores 0 for that part and is explained in the reasons. News items do not use this formula.

matching_note: Version matching is approximate. It compares dotted version numbers and a flattened, capped list of NVD CPE ranges. It does not evaluate NVD's AND/OR configuration trees, and many CISA KEV entries have no version range at all.
